tasks.title: Bootstrap typed project and test toolchain
deliverables: Python package and compatible pinned dependency lockfile
Credential-free test/lint commands and configuration defaulting to paper
acceptance: Fresh checkout installs reproducibly
Default tests need no credentials; no real calls or secrets

tasks.title: Define domain contracts and authority
deliverables: Pydantic contracts/exported schemas and Decimal money types
Provider-neutral and broker protocols with capability/error types
Owner-versus-role authority checks
acceptance: Invalid units/fields/actions fail locally
Domain imports no SDK or graph runtime

tasks.title: Persist business state, journal and outbox
deliverables: SQLite schema/migrations, repositories, immutable revisions
Atomic state/event/outbox transactions, uniqueness constraints and process lease
Consistent backup/restore
acceptance: Duplicate IDs cannot create duplicate financial records (A09)
Committed state survives restart; corrupt backup detected (A36)

tasks.title: Build native ledger and EUR performance
deliverables: Native postings, FIFO lots, partial-fill and multi-asset fees
External flows, expense accrual/settlement and EUR valuations
USD10000 account and separate deployment real-cost ledger
acceptance: A01-A05 exact accounting and no double deduction
A43-A44 FX, paper reset and shared-cost allocation

tasks.title: Implement public market snapshots and replay
deliverables: Public venue metadata/feed normalization and reconnect/backfill
Deterministic features, freshness/available-at times and replay clock
acceptance: A13 stale/gapped data handling
A26 no future observations; network smoke separately labeled

tasks.title: Implement paper broker and fill assumptions
deliverables: Virtual orders/balances, partial fills, cancellations and fees
Latency/depth/queue assumptions and shared broker conformance
Rolling fee-tier state or explicit conservative fixed tier
acceptance: Same ledger path as live; precision/minimums pass A03/A11/A12
No guaranteed limit-touch or hindsight same-bar fill

tasks.title: Implement OpenAI and Anthropic adapters
deliverables: Responses/Messages translations, schemas/tools/errors/usage
Approved-model capability registry and scripted fixtures
acceptance: A17 provider failure/structured-output fixtures
One-provider setup works; actual credential probes separately reported

tasks.title: Enforce expense budgets and usage receipts
deliverables: Atomic nested reservations, versioned prices and receipt gateway
Bounded repairs/retries/fallbacks and uncertain billing
Invoice reconciliation and global/role/task/version expense views
acceptance: A06-A08/A18 concurrency and unknown-cost tests
Leadership/Engineer cannot bypass gateway; paper gains cannot refill budget

tasks.title: Implement reliable execution and pause profiles
deliverables: Authorized intents, outbox and cash/quantity reservations
Unknown-order reconciliation, deduplicated fills and startup recovery
All pause profiles, deterministic protection and flatten workflow
acceptance: A09-A16 crash/cancel/fill cases
Unknown filled order not resubmitted; owner halt persists

tasks.title: Build durable graph scheduling and context
deliverables: Thin LangGraph, durable scheduler/checkpoints/leases
Root budgets/depth bounds, coalescing and delayed retries
Snapshots, cursors, bounded evidence and version validation
acceptance: A19-A20 recovery/delegation tests
No obsolete trade catch-up; every paid call uses gateway

tasks.title: Implement Research and autonomous Trader
deliverables: Cached sourced research and bounded safe fetch/search
Two unproven strategy templates and mandate-driven Trader
Trade/adjust/hold/no-action contracts and direct research delivery
acceptance: A21-A23 real discretion without Leader per-trade approval
Errors not disguised as holds; stale sources and injection handled

tasks.title: Implement Learning and Optimisation
deliverables: Evidence-batched role workflows and revised lessons/counterevidence
Experiments/no-trade evaluations and cost/quality metrics
acceptance: A24-A26 provenance and point-in-time evaluation
Winning/losing decisions not graded only by outcome

tasks.title: Implement Leader and software Secretary
deliverables: Digests, task routing and material-event escalation
Leader rationale/evidence/outcome and scoped consultation
Mandates, resource/schedule allocation and authorised change tasks
acceptance: Leader cannot raise owner budget or lift owner halt
No order approval committee; bounded meaningful experimentation

tasks.title: Implement isolated artifact Engineer
deliverables: Authorized worktrees, patch tools and allowlisted artifact classes
Independent trusted checks, manifests and attestations
Spend/resource/path bounds and failed-candidate evidence
acceptance: A27-A30/A33 actual tested artifact, not advice
No production secrets/DB or mutable test gates

tasks.title: Activate versions and roll back safely
deliverables: Candidate lifecycle, fingerprints and baseline compare-and-set
Quiescent activation/restart, observation and rollback
Opening/closing version provenance retained
acceptance: A31-A32 stale/failed activation tests
Next decision uses new version; rollback never erases fills/costs

tasks.title: Deliver dashboard and owner controls
deliverables: FastAPI projections and responsive financial/organisation/cost/change views
Authenticated owner configuration/budget/pause controls
Redacted evidence navigation and live prerequisite state
acceptance: A34-A35/A37 reconciliation and permissions
Paper P&L, actual spend and uncertain/degraded states clearly labeled

tasks.title: Deliver offline full-loop and fault suite
deliverables: Reproducible offline demo and machine-readable evidence report
Property/recovery/provenance/security/engineering tests
Rejected change, budget exhaustion and restart scenarios
acceptance: Applicable A01-A38 plus A43-A44 actually tested
Complete trade/learn/implement/activate/recover loop without credentials

tasks.title: Package R1 and run funded paper soak
deliverables: Tested CLI/deployment/backup commands
Public-data and credentialed-model paper soak with owner budget
Verification report and actual versus forecast expense
acceptance: Fresh checkout runs offline demonstration
Paid smoke is opt-in; absent credentials are pending, not passed; live disabled

tasks.title: Evaluate forward-paper net economics
deliverables: Predeclared baselines, held-out forward evaluation and trial registry
After-friction/all-in performance and uncertainty/sensitivity report
acceptance: Supported/not-supported/insufficient-evidence are all valid outputs
Failed engineering/external costs included; no in-sample profitability claims

tasks.title: Implement conditionally eligible live adapter
deliverables: Owner-selected venue adapter with metadata/fees/order lookups
Least-privilege keys, read-only reconciliation and conformance evidence
Documented native protection and uncertainty semantics
acceptance: Same core ledger/execution interfaces; no withdrawal capability
Authenticated or real-order tests require separate owner authority

tasks.title: Gate a bounded live pilot
deliverables: Private eligibility and explicit owner allocation/budget record
Live enablement gate and measured paper/live differences
Protection/recovery and continuation/stop report
acceptance: Paper USD10000 never sets real live allocation
Diagnostic pilot without strong economic evidence labeled; limits enforced

tasks.title: Separate protected kernel for broader code
deliverables: Credentialed kernel process and unprivileged mutable code via scoped RPC
Owner-pinned controller/tests/images and protected policy
Actual-host adversarial capability/resource/egress testing
acceptance: A39-A40 malicious code cannot reach keys/budgets/accounting/gates
Rollback does not depend on failing model/candidate

tasks.title: Extend Engineer to plugins and selected code
deliverables: Owner-granted pure-plugin then selected application-code classes
Immutable builds/staging/shadow and compatible migration policy
Automatic tested activation and deterministic rollback
acceptance: A41-A42 proven before broader authority
Routine granted changes autonomous; new budgets/venues/kernel remain owner-only
